documents.stance_why: The guideline leaves AI permission to each instructor ('Whether you determine AI use is appropriate in your course or not') and sets no university-wide ban or permission; it tells instructors to put expectations in the syllabus, not to use AI detectors, and to follow the Honor Policy.
